Empty exclude_selectors list does not affect output

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"exclude_selectors\":[]}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Hello world</p>", options)
    println(result.content)
}
```
